question: Which of the following units of a train AC consists of pressure gauges and pressure cutouts to protect the compressor against high pressure?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gauge board.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gauge board__ is a crucial component of the train AC system.
 
• It consists of pressure gauges and pressure cutouts to ensure the compressor's safety.
 
• The pressure gauges monitor system pressure levels in real-time.
 
• The pressure cutouts protect the compressor from damage caused by high pressure.
 
• This ensures the reliable and efficient functioning of the AC system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Compressor:**

 
 
• The compressor is responsible for circulating refrigerant throughout the AC system.
 
• It compresses the refrigerant to a high pressure and temperature.
 
 
 
• **Evaporator unit: **
 
 
• It is responsible for cooling the air by absorbing heat from the surroundings.
 
• Refrigerant flows through the evaporator to extract heat from the air.
 
 
 
• **Condenser:**
 
 
• The condenser dissipates heat from the refrigerant to the outside environment.
 
• It converts the high-pressure gas refrigerant into a liquid state.
